name: codex-continuum
description: Universal Windows live-session continuation package for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Continue any live Codex PowerShell project window.
interface.longDescription: Codex Continuum binds to a live Codex PowerShell window by project name, process id, or window handle. It watches for Working to clear, then types continue and presses Enter in that same live session.
defaultPrompt: Probe a Continuum target before running.
